title: Let a run take its serial key input
description: No run with the serial key of a WaitingOnKey run submitted before it holds the key any more: each of them ended, was cancelled, failed to start, ended on its route or was orphaned at a restart, and the runtime let go each one it had taken up (its run thread in the daemon returned). The run is Submitted again and is taken up as a submitted run is (its routes are read again first: WaitForRoute). The daemon also writes the run event `runbook.key-taken` (record: serial_key); see CancelRun for why it is stated here. Issued by the daemon itself (actor DaemonProcess): it has no route in the HTTP contract.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.
